initial_observation.encounter_context: presented to the emergency department with acute-onset left flank pain
initial_observation.first_contact_summary: Pain began while at rest, maximum intensity within minutes, radiated to left shoulder, described as “kicked in the back.” Denied fevers, nausea, vomiting, dysuria, and hematuria. Two weeks prior had COVID-19 diagnosed via nasopharyngeal PCR. Medical history notable for iron deficiency anemia and appendectomy. On oral combined estrogen-progesterone contraceptive. Denied family history of renal disease or coagulopathic disorders. Initial vitals: heart rate 109, blood pressure 135/84, oxygen saturation 99%, respiratory rate 18, temp 36.9C. Abdominal exam: soft, nondistended, focal left upper quadrant tenderness, severe left costovertebral angle tenderness. Laboratory: WBC 13.8 cells/mm3, hemoglobin 13.4 g/dl, PT 14 s, APTT 35.4 s, INR 1.1. Urine: microhematuria, negative pregnancy test. Chest x-ray unremarkable.
known_prior_history: COVID-19 infection diagnosed two weeks prior
use of oral combined estrogen-progesterone contraceptive

evidence_items.source_text: Non-contrast computed tomography of her abdomen and pelvis demonstrated left peri-renal moderate volume hemorrhage with a fat dense lesion in the left kidney measuring 2.5 × 2.3 × 2.1 cm, consistent with ruptured renal AML.
Laboratory studies revealed: white blood cell count 13.8 cells/mm3, hemoglobin 13.4 g/dl, PT 14 s, APTT 35.4 s, INR 1.1. Urine studies showed microhematuria and a negative pregnancy test.
Interventional radiology performed embolization 12 h after admission. The intraprocedural evaluation of the renal artery system found no aneurysmal dilatation.

The patient's post-procedural course was complicated by continued hemorrhage and retroperitoneal hematoma, with a hemoglobin nadir of 6.8 g/dl requiring transfusion of 2 units packed red blood cells. She also developed diaphragmatic irritation and required supplemental oxygen by nasal canula.
On hospital day 6 she developed respiratory COVID-19 symptoms and again tested positive by PCR assay for COVID-19.

Non-contrast computed tomography of her abdomen and pelvis demonstrated left peri-renal moderate volume hemorrhage with a fat dense lesion in the left kidney measuring 2.5 × 2.3 × 2.1 cm, consistent with ruptured renal AML.

hidden_reference.final_diagnosis_verbatim: a ruptured renal AML two weeks after COVID-19 infection
